# snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26

The goal of `snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26` is to make available the code and
data to reproduce the results of an analysis presented at the [Research
on Research Event 2026](https://crsuzh.pages.uzh.ch/ror-event-2026/)
which was held on 29 January 2026 in Zürich, Switzerland. The event has
been organized by the [Center for Reproducible Science and Research
Synthesis](https://www.crs.uzh.ch/en.html).

The poster presented is available on
[Zenodo](https://doi.org/10.46446/snsf-oa-poster-ror-event-26) and can
be cited as follows:

> Gorin, S. (2026). *Monitoring open access publications at the SNSF:
> Challenges of open academic data* \[Poster presentation\]. Research on
> Research Event 2026, Zürich, Switzerland.
> <https://doi.org/10.46446/snsf-oa-poster-ror-event-26>.

The package, its code and the analysis contained in the vignette can be
cited as follows:

> Gorin S (2026). *snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26: Code and data for an analysis
> of the SNSF OA monitoring presented at ROR Zürich 2026*. R package
> version 0.1.0, <https://snsf-data.github.io/snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26/>.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26` like
so:

``` r
devtools::install_github("snsf-data/snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26")
```

## Example

The code to reproduce the analysis is available in the [“Monitoring open
access publications at the SNSF: the challenges of open academic data”
vignette](https://snsf-data.github.io/snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26/articles/ror_presentation.html)
under the article section.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`dp_snsf_works`](https://snsf-data.github.io/snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26/reference/dp_snsf_works.md)
  [`oax_snsf_works`](https://snsf-data.github.io/snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26/reference/dp_snsf_works.md)
  [`dim_snsf_works`](https://snsf-data.github.io/snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26/reference/dp_snsf_works.md)
  [`cr_snsf_works`](https://snsf-data.github.io/snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26/reference/dp_snsf_works.md)
  : SNSF publications data
- [`get_snsf_oa_work()`](https://snsf-data.github.io/snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26/reference/get_snsf_oa_work.md)
  : Get SNSF OA monitoring data from Github
- [`get_snsf_work_dp()`](https://snsf-data.github.io/snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26/reference/get_snsf_work_dp.md)
  [`get_snsf_work_dim()`](https://snsf-data.github.io/snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26/reference/get_snsf_work_dp.md)
  [`get_snsf_work_oax()`](https://snsf-data.github.io/snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26/reference/get_snsf_work_dp.md)
  [`get_snsf_work_cr()`](https://snsf-data.github.io/snsf.oa.ror.zurich.26/reference/get_snsf_work_dp.md)
  : Get SNSF related scientific work from databases
